passage.quote: Every section within the manual's Instructions chapter remains visible.

summary: Browse every pinned instruction entry and distinguish accepted forms, restricted core models and entries without a documented mapping.
Read original explanations alongside exact, syntax-highlighted project Lean code and proof links, without distributing the vendor manual.
Rebuild a portable static site deterministically and reject stale generated pages or source mappings.
remaining: All instruction-section entries are indexed. Accepted leaf forms and explicitly mapped restricted models have pages; this does not enumerate every PTX type/modifier combination or certify hardware behavior.

from.quote:
The HTML reference makes every instruction entry from the pinned PTX9.4
instruction-section inventory discoverable in a searchable table.

Restricted core models also have pages, clearly separated from accepted leaf
forms.

That page explains its behavior in
project-authored words, gives operand and target restrictions, distinguishes
source review from Lean proof validity, and displays the associated Lean
computation with links to the full definitions and proofs.

A stale output, missing mapping or stale accepted
source hash must fail the documentation check rather than silently show old code.

Coloring is a reading aid, not semantic analysis;
it preserves the displayed source and works without JavaScript.
